name: Order of the Creed
body:
Edicts: The xia must protect the lives, holdings, and rights of his chosen organization at all costs, obey its leaders without question, and strive to expand its power and prestige. (An organization must have a dogma/mission and at least 20 members; the xia may switch organizations once previous commitments are fully honored).

Challenge: Receives a +1 circumstance bonus on attack rolls against the challenged target if it has been declared an enemy of the organization. Increases by +1 for every four levels.

Skills: Adds Knowledge (local) and Perception as class skills. Receives a bonus equal to +1/2 level (minimum +1) on Perception checks to identify enemies of his organization.

Order Abilities
Implacable Resolve (Ex): At 2nd level, when defending an organization’s charge, site, object, or pursuing its direct goal, add Charisma bonus on all saves against effects that would deter or hinder him.
Rallying Cry (Ex): At 8th level, as a standard action, grant all allies within 30 ft. who can see or hear him a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, or combat maneuver checks for 1 round (allies may each receive different bonuses, but benefit once per combat).
Fortifying Presence (Ex): At 15th level, adjacent allies gain DR 1/—. As an immediate action, the xia can redirect an attack made against an adjacent creature to himself if the attacker is within the xia’s reach (resolved against the xia’s AC/defenses, ignoring cover/concealment).
